about: Accepted ways out of the new reader (LAUNCH_PLAN §4, owner 2026-11-10). scripts/exits-crawl.mjs fails on any same-site link answered by Django that matches none of these. Each wave that ports a page removes its entry; nothing is added without the owner. `match` is a regular expression on the path and query of the address as linked (or, for a host entry, on the host).
